modules.name: Orbital Uno
modules.description: Spatial Discovery System — core module. Places a sound in 360° around the listener and moves it.

modules.name: Orbital MAS
modules.description: Modular Array Source — adds one more source to Uno. Place it next to Uno (either side).

modules.name: Orbital Bypass
modules.description: Expander for Uno: bypasses Uno's own outputs and sends Uno's mix out through Bypass instead, together with four extra stereo channels. Place it anywhere in the Orbital row, on either side, next to any Orbital module that connects back to Uno.

modules.name: Orbital Vector
modules.description: Expander for Uno: turns a source's movement into CV (angle, distance, speed, X and Y) to modulate anything else in your patch. Place it anywhere in the Orbital row, on either side, next to any Orbital module that connects back to Uno.

modules.name: Orbital Starfield
modules.description: Resizable blank panel: a piece of star chart with slowly twinkling LED stars. Drag an edge to resize.
